events.title: A rover mission reaches Mars
events.description: Pathfinder lands carrying the small Sojourner rover.

events.title: A major investment fund needs rescue
events.description: Banks and securities firms invest in Long-Term Capital Management after heavy losses threaten its survival.

events.title: The euro begins
events.description: Eleven countries start sharing a currency for financial transactions. Euro notes and coins will arrive later.

what_happened_next.text:
Intel finished at nearly ten times its starting value, and Microsoft at about six times. Disney and both broad share baskets also gained. The window ends in August 2000; changes after that date are outside this result. One five-year period is only a slice of history.

The years ahead brought Pathfinder to Mars and a rescue of the investment fund Long-Term Capital Management after heavy losses. The euro began as a shared currency for financial transactions in 1999. Notes and coins came later. Scientific advances and financial trouble happened in the same period; the world did not follow a single upbeat or gloomy story.

The ending date matters. A gain measured through August 2000 says nothing by itself about money invested for longer or bought at a different price. Look at the full path and ask how you would have felt during its setbacks. A stock can finish with a large gain without giving its owner a smooth five years.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: Windows 95, Netscape’s stock-market debut and Disney’s expansion made technology and entertainment exciting news.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: The chosen chip and software shares gained much more than the broad basket in this window. They still had difficult months, and their results do not describe every technology company.
reflection.what_faded_away: The launch-day buzz did not tell you the size of five-year gains. New leadership and big deals were plans whose results still had to unfold.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: Nobody knew the exact path or the final ranking. Stopping the chart in August 2000 leaves later events outside the result.
